metadata.title: European privacy fines: documented decisions and amounts per resident
metadata.description: Frozen collection of 1042 documented decisions across ten countries. Collection as of 2026-10-25; population on 1 January 2026. Unequal periods, mixed legal regimes, missing amounts and recorded appeal stages retained. Not a national census or enforcement-risk ranking. Study: https://www.legiscope.com/blog/europe-data-protection-fines-per-capita.html. CC BY 4.0 covers original Legiscope data/documentation; utility code is MIT and third-party source rights remain reserved.
